examples.text:
machine mz-1
vars:
  h in [0, 30], start {16, 18}, out of range: clamp
  v in [-6, 3], start {-3, -2}, out of range: crash
  f in [0, 9], start {9}, out of range: clamp
controls:
  @throttle: DEC none, KEEP 0, INC 1
random $w: none
rules (in order, each tick):
  1. if all(f >= 1): v := v + 2*@throttle - 1
  2. if all(f <= 0): v := v - 1
  3. f := f - @throttle
  4. h := h + v
crash if any holds:
  1. all(h == 0, v < -1)
goal: all(h == 0, v >= -1)

machine mz-1
vars:
  x in [0, 24], start {3, 5}, out of range: clamp
  v in [-1, 4], start {3, 4}, out of range: clamp
  f in [0, 12], start {12}, out of range: clamp
controls:
  @engine: DEC -1, KEEP 0, INC 1
random $w each tick:
  -1 with probability 1/10
  0 with probability 8/10
  1 with probability 1/10
rules (in order, each tick):
  1. if all(@engine != 0, f >= 1): v := v + @engine
  2. if any(@engine == 0, f <= 0): v := v - sgn(v)
  3. f := f - abs(@engine)
  4. v := v + $w
  5. x := x + v
crash if any holds:
  1. all(x >= 20, v >= 3)
goal: all(x >= 20, v <= 2)

machine mz-1
vars:
  y in [0, 18], start {0, 1}, out of range: clamp
  v in [0, 2], start {0}, out of range: clamp
  o in [0, 1], start {0}, out of range: clamp
  ph in [-1, 5], start {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5}, out of range: clamp
controls:
  @acc: DEC -1, KEEP 0, INC 1
random $w: none
rules (in order, each tick):
  1. if all(ph == 5): ph := -1
  2. ph := ph + 1
  3. o := 0
  4. if all(ph <= 2): o := 1
  5. v := v + @acc
  6. y := y + v
crash if any holds:
  1. all(y >= 9, y <= 11, o == 1)
goal: all(y >= 16)
extension mz-1x:
  reply delay: 1 tick (a command decided now is applied that many ticks later; KEEP is in flight at start)
  hidden vars (never displayed): ph
  history shown: last 3 displayed observations

quickstart.canonical_text:
machine mz-1
vars:
  level in [0, 12], start {2, 3}, out of range: crash
  valve in [0, 2], start {0}, out of range: clamp
controls:
  @pump: DEC none, KEEP 0, INC 1
  @drain: DEC -1, KEEP 0, INC 1
random $w each tick:
  0 with probability 3/4
  1 with probability 1/4
rules (in order, each tick):
  1. valve := valve + @drain
  2. level := level - valve + 2*@pump + $w
crash if any holds:
  1. all(level >= 12)
goal: all(level >= 8, level <= 9, valve == 0)
quickstart.loose_text:
machine mz-1
vars:
  level in [0, 12], start {2, 3}, out of range: crash
  valve in [0, 2], start {0}, out of range: clamp
controls:
  @pump: DEC none, KEEP 0, INC 1
  @drain: DEC -1, KEEP 0, INC 1
random $w each tick:
  0 with probability 3/4
  1 with probability 1/4
rules (in order, each tick):
  1. valve := @drain + valve
  2. level := level + 2*@pump - valve + $w
crash if any holds:
  1. level >= 12
goal: all(level >= 8, level <= 9, valve == 0)
